title: RAW UNREVIEWED: lunar increase and decrease condition bodily outcomes and physician attention
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. In Morgan M.721's complete 5v-B stanza, lunar increase/decrease is linked to humors and animal/plant life, strength/weakness, and a directive to the healer of infirm bodies to attend to it; failures are associated with lunar consumption. Model a conditional astronomical-to-medical chain, not a common word treated as a proper name. The source gives no fixed treatment protocol or phase-day table.

source.span: Morgan M.721, normalized complete local poem, f.5v-B, 'Effecti della luna', all eight lines in AI_COMPLETE_READING.md
source.observed_content: The stanza attributes effects to humors, animals and plants; links lunar increase/decrease with strength/weakness; addresses the healer of infirm bodies; and says many fail during lunar consumption.
source.layer: Retained source-only reading of one late-fifteenth-century witness; normalized reading, not a diplomatic transcription or independent textual comparison

potential_admitted_target: None asserted. Producer made no target observation; root must name the permitted complete unit for any later review.

design.mechanism: Keep separate roles in one directed account: a changing lunar condition (increase versus decrease/consumption), affected recipients (humors and living bodies), opposed strength/weakness outcomes, and a healer who must attend to the state of an infirm body. The further failure-under-consumption statement is a conditional medical consequence, not a treatment instruction. Do not assign a lexical sign to Moon, light, humors, strength, illness, or physician from this source alone.
design.unit: The whole M.721 5v-B stanza and immediate local context as preserved in AI_COMPLETE_READING.md; no Voynich unit was accessed in this pass.
design.observable_consequence: A source-shaped reading of a future root-selected complete unit must support more than a luminary label: it would need a shared participant/state relation carrying opposite temporal polarity into an opposed bodily outcome and a medically owned consequence or directive. A repeated body name or light association without a phase-conditioned recipient/outcome relation does not satisfy this design. No claim is made that any such target feature exists.
design.scope: Source-only raw hypothesis; unselected, untested, no target glosses or assigned word values

execution_requirements: Root first identifies an already permitted complete unit and owns any target inspection; this producer does not reopen target text or imagery.
Compare at least two opposed state contexts within the same bounded unit and require a bodily recipient/outcome plus a distinct medical directive or consequence bound to the state.
Retain a no-cycle/name-only rival and a noncausal adjacency rival; do not repair missing links with free glosses.
Keep source claims historical and attributed, not biomedical facts.
assumptions_and_limits: M.721 is a normalized reading; line 1's exact initial conjunction/wording is uncertain, while increase/decrease, humors, strength/weakness, healer of infirm bodies, and failure under consumption are retained in the source reading.
The stanza gives no fixed phase-day labels or treatment protocol, and does not specify a particular remedy or dose.
No proper-name, English lexical value, target meaning, target availability, or fit is established.

IDEA000796 concerns received sunlight and Earth-facing brightness in a different stanza; IDEA000765 concerns an astral/pharma chain in Sloane73. They are nearby comparison families, not evidence that this proposal duplicates or confirms either design.
